title: Juicy Cozy Argentinian Spinach Stir-fry
description: This herbal, juicy spinich stir-fry features a marinated spinach dish with a cozy and delicious flavor profile that is nut-free-friendly and perfect for any meal.
instructions: Prepare the spinach by washing it thoroughly, then chop into small pieces.
In a large skillet or wok, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add garlic cloves and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Add the onion and red bell pepper to the skillet, stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes until softened.
Add the chopped spinach and balsamic vinegar to the pan. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes until the spinach has wilted down and starts to release its moisture.
If using, add red chili flakes for a slight heat kick. Season with salt and pepper to taste based on your preference. Stir fry together until well combined and heated through.
Serve hot as a side dish or over rice.
